rationale.overall: B better matches the REFERENCE's lit solid read—continuous volumetric shading and warm falloff across the slab—so it wins overall despite A's crisper edges.
rationale.material: B shows soft form gradients, surface mottling, and translucent light wrap on the slab closer to the REFERENCE, while A reads flatter with harder facet breaks and more uniform dark fill.
rationale.silhouette: A holds a sharper, more even dark outline against the two-tone ground, whereas B lightens and softens the block's upper-right boundary.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px A stays a compact dark bar with a decisive orange underline, while B's lighter top end mush into the pale field slightly more.
